question: 订单总数是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

question: 按客户统计订单金额
expected_sql: SELECT customer, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer ORDER BY total_amount DESC

question: 销售额最高的 10 个商品
expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS sales FROM order_items AS i JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 10

question: 查看每月订单金额趋势
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 已支付订单的平均金额
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
expected_analysis: 返回已支付订单平均金额

question: 列出每个客户的订单数
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name

question: 订单金额超过一万元的客户
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(amount) > 10000
expected_analysis: 筛选累计金额超过阈值的客户

question: 按销售额给商品排名
expected_sql: SELECT product_id, sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS sales FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id) AS product_sales
expected_analysis: 输出商品销售额和排名

question: 最近七天每天的访问量
expected_sql: SELECT toDate(event_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS visits FROM website_traffic WHERE event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
expected_analysis: 展示最近七天访问趋势

question: 按金额区间统计订单数量
expected_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN amount < 100 THEN 'low' WHEN amount < 1000 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'high' END AS amount_segment, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY amount_segment
expected_analysis: 展示低中高金额订单分布

question: 查找金额高于平均值的订单
expected_sql: SELECT id, customer_id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM orders)
expected_analysis: 返回高于总体平均金额的订单

question: 今年有下单的客户数
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE)
expected_analysis: 返回本年度下单客户去重数
